newsitem.title: USA: Energy Ventures to buy TA Industries.
newsitem.headline: Energy Ventures to buy TA Industries.

text.p: Energy Ventures Inc said Monday it has signed a definitive agreement to buy TA Industries Inc for about $64 million in cash and assumption of debt.
TA Industries, with 1996 revenues of $80 million, makes tubular couplings and accessories used in oil well drilling and marketed under the brand names Texas Arai and Tube-Alloy.
Energy Ventures said that upon completion of the transaction, Texas Arai and Tube-Alloy will become divisions of Grant Prideco, its drilling tools and premium tubulars segment.
It said the acquisition is expected to provide manufacturing synergies with a unit called TCA, which it acquired in August.
Through those synergies, Energy Ventures said it expects to save between $1.5 and $2.5 million a year in costs and reduce current inventory levels at TA Industries by up to $8 million.
